Orange County is a Piedmont county absorbing growth from three directions, with Lake of the Woods and the Route 3 corridor pulling Fredericksburg commuters, the US-15 and US-29 corridors linking it to Culpeper, and Gordonsville oriented toward Charlottesville. The Town of Orange and Gordonsville hold the public water and sewer, so most commercial and higher-density development has to locate there or pay to extend service.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
